slides.title: Moyale's displaced: no camp, no food stocks
people displaced, Kenya Red Cross says
slides.body: Up from an estimated 36,000, including families staying with relatives and host communities. The total has not been independently confirmed.

slides.title: sites hosting Ethiopians in Kenya
slides.body: Families arrived with little food, no cooking utensils or bedding. Diarrhoea is spreading and families fear malaria, Al Jazeera reports.

slides.title: No refugee camp yet
slides.body: Kenya's acting refugee commissioner said there are no contingency food stocks for this crisis, and a camp cannot be set up until security improves.

slides.title: Ethiopian Red Cross aid inside Ethiopia
slides.body: Shelter and household items (about $183,000) for 1,000 displaced households in and around Moyale town.

slides.title: price rises reported by traders
slides.body: Trucks moving goods between Mombasa and Addis Ababa have been stranded near the border for almost two weeks, a local peace committee said.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Let aid reach displaced families.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
